criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Executives: Strategy, Value and Risk (EXE-501); AI Governance for Boards and Directors (EXE-502); The AI Business Case: Investment and ROI (EXE-503); AI Regulatory and Compliance Exposure: An Executive Briefing (EXE-507). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
